cohort: 100 pregnant women with oligohydramnios (AFI <= 5cm) at >34 weeks gestation and 100 pregnant women with normal AFI (8-24cm) at >34 weeks gestation.
finding: Oligohydramnios (AFI <=5cm) at >34 weeks gestation was associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, including lower birth weight, increased NICU admissions, and higher rates of perinatal mortality, and also increased rates of cesarean delivery
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in the oligohydramnios group (55%) compared to the control group (19%).
birth_weight: Birth weight <2.5 kg was found in 60% of the oligohydramnios group and 18% of the control group, with mean birth weights of 2.3kg and 2.9kg respectively.
